sources.shipping: Express shipping takes two business days. Standard shipping takes five business days. Shipping tracking links are sent by email. International shipping is available. Shipping costs are shown at checkout.
sources.refund: Refund requests are accepted within thirty days of purchase. Refund payments take seven business days. Refunds require your order number. Refund shipping costs are non-refundable. Refund requests can be submitted in the account dashboard.
sources.warranty: The product warranty lasts twelve months. Warranty coverage includes manufacturing defects. Warranty claims require proof of purchase. Warranty replacements are shipped free of charge. Warranty coverage excludes accidental damage.
sources.cancellation: Subscription cancellation is available in the billing portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period. Cancellation preserves access until the renewal date. Cancellation removes automatic renewal. Cancellation does not delete your workspace.
sources.upload: Document upload accepts PDF, DOCX, TXT, and Markdown files. Each upload must be under ten megabytes. Upload processing creates searchable chunks. Scanned PDF uploads require OCR first. Upload failures appear in the Knowledge tab.
sources.widget: The widget is installed with a JavaScript script tag. Widget installation requires a published agent. Widget position can be left or right. Widget colors are customized in Settings. The widget opens the hosted chat in an iframe.
sources.authentication: Authentication uses secure password hashes and HttpOnly cookies. Authentication sessions expire after seven days. Authentication passwords must contain ten characters. Google authentication is optional. Authentication API keys can be revoked.
sources.analytics: Analytics show conversation counts and average confidence. Analytics include p95 response latency. Analytics show estimated token costs. Analytics highlight unanswered questions. Analytics retain retrieval traces for inspection.
sources.retraining: Retraining rebuilds document chunks and embeddings. Retraining can be started in Knowledge. Retraining updates website sources from their URL. Retraining runs asynchronously. Retraining evaluates source retrieval after indexing.
sources.privacy: Privacy isolation scopes documents to one agent. Privacy checks prevent owners accessing other workspaces. Privacy protections reject private network URLs. Privacy controls keep API secrets out of frontend bundles. Privacy limits public keys to chatting with a single agent.
